model: PATEK PHILIPPE Aquanaut 5167A-001 (40 mm steel, black embossed dial, black composite rubber strap)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot (at hand height). FIRST PATEK PHILIPPE and the AQUANAUT TEMPLATE (config key 5167a001; the 5168G green / blue, 42.2 mm white gold, copy this spec and change only what differs: case_mm in the measure file, dial / hands / strap colours, emissions): structure of the Audemars Piguet Offshore Diver build (case slab from the alpha silhouette sloping into the strap, bezel ring sampled by rays from the pivot with a polished chamfer, hands from profile lists, crown as a separate part) with the rounded-octagon Aquanaut case: the bezel outer edge is a superellipse cut back to the silhouette, the window is the scanned rounded square, the dial is a flat polygon with the embossed 'Tropical' grid dial as the native photo map (texture only), one fluted crown at 3 o'clock, and the composite rubber strap as ONE piece (its embossed grid pad is texture only) between lug inner walls and ends measured on the photo.

case.note: case slab = silhouette between the lug tips (tip_top / tip_bottom, 0.25 mm grid, sum a multiple of 0.25) with the crown rows replaced by a straight line, top and bottom sloping toward the strap; bezel = superellipse ring (min of the superellipse and the silhouette less silhouette_margin_mm, sampled by rays) at bezel_z, then a chamfer ring down to the dial window at chamfer_z

dial.note: flat polygon (the window less the chamfer) with the native photo map: embossed grid, applied numerals, indices, minute track, date window and the photographed hands stay in the map

hands.note: profile = [mm along the hand from the pivot (negative = tail), half width] from tail to tip, last point at the traced length; measured from edge fits in rows rotated about the pivot (threshold 112 for the steel frame, 205 for the lume inlay). lume = [s, half width] of the white inlay. Hands and hub use hands_photo (reference photo projected from the front)

crown.note: crowns come from trace.crowns: a lathe about the axis (profile = [radius, mm along the axis] from the base point), flutes are texture

strap.note: strap.kind rubber, ONE full-width piece: edges = trace.strap_y_left_right_mm (silhouette outside the lug zone, measured lug inner walls inside it), from under the bezel (18.5 mm) to the rounded ends; the embossed grid pad of the photo is texture only

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
